```{r}
#| context: setup
library(shiny)
require(bslib)
require(ShortForm)
require(psych)
require(future)
require(promises)
# Set up future for async execution
plan(multisession, workers = 2)

sim_model <- "
f1 =~ x1 + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6 + x7 + x8 + x9 + x10
f2 =~ x11 + x12 + x13 + x14 + x15 + x16 + x17 + x18 + x19 + x20
f3 =~ x21 + x22 + x23 + x24 + x25 + x26 + x27 + x28 + x29 + x30"

sim_data <-
  cbind(
    psych::sim.rasch(nvar = 10)$items, #psych::sim.rasch(nvar = 5)$items,
    psych::sim.rasch(nvar = 10)$items, #psych::sim.rasch(nvar = 5)$items,
    psych::sim.rasch(nvar = 10)$items#, psych::sim.rasch(nvar = 5)$items
  )

colnames(sim_data) = paste0("x", 1:30)

debug = FALSE
```

#| context: server
#| label: algorithm_help
output$algorithm_help <- renderUI({
    req(input$algorithm)
    
    help_file <- switch(input$algorithm,
        "Ant Colony Optimization" = help(antcolony.lavaan, package = "ShortForm"),
        "Simulated Annealing" = help(simulatedAnnealing, package = "ShortForm"),
        "Tabu Search" = help(tabuShortForm, package = "ShortForm")
    )
    
    if (length(help_file) == 0) {
        return(p("Help page not found", style = "color: red;"))
    }

    html_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".html")
    tools::Rd2HTML(utils:::.getHelpFile(help_file), out = html_file)
        HTML(paste(readLines(html_file, warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"))
    })

```{r}
#| context: server
#| label: define-selected-algorithm

algorithm_task <- ExtendedTask$new(function(choice, args) {

    model <- sim_model
    data <- sim_data
    # if (choice == "Tabu Search") {
    #             if (debug) cat("Running Tabu Search synchronously\n")
                
    #             result <- ShortForm::tabuShortForm(
    #                 originalData = data,
    #                 initialModel = model,
    #                 numItems = args$numItems,
    #                 niter = args$niter,
    #                 tabu.size = args$tabu.size,
    #                 lavaan.model.specs = args$lavaan.model.specs,
    #                 parallel = FALSE,
    #                 verbose = args$verbose
    #             )
                
    #             return(promise_resolve(result))
    #         }

    future({
            if (debug) cat("Inside promise, about to run algorithm\n")

                result <- switch(
                    choice,
                    "Ant Colony Optimization" =
                        ShortForm::antcolony.lavaan(
                            data = data,
                            ants = args$ants,
                            evaporation = args$evaporation,
                            antModel = model,
                            list.items = args$list.items,
                            full = args$full,
                            i.per.f = args$i.per.f,
                            factors = args$factors,
                            steps = args$steps,
                            pheromone.calculation = args$pheromone.calculation,
                            max.run = args$max.run,
                            parallel = args$parallel
                        ),
                    "Simulated Annealing" =
                        ShortForm::simulatedAnnealing(
                            initialModel = model,
                            originalData = data,
                            setChains = args$setChains,
                            maxItems = args$maxItems,
                            items = args$items,
                            maxSteps = args$maxSteps,
                            temperature = args$temperature,
                            parallel = args$parallel
                        ),
                    'Tabu Search' =
                        ShortForm::tabuShortForm(
                            originalData = data,
                            initialModel = model,
                            numItems = args$numItems,
                            niter = args$niter,
                            tabu.size = args$tabu.size,
                            lavaan.model.specs = args$lavaan.model.specs,
                            parallel = FALSE
                        )
                )
                if (debug) cat("Algorithm execution complete\n")
            
            if (debug) cat("Result called\n")
                
            return(result)
            
}, seed = TRUE)
})
```

```{r}
#| context: server
#| label: status-message

ant_frames <- list(
  "🐜→→→ 🐧 Searching for solution...",
  "→🐜→→ 🐧 Searching for solution...",
  "→→🐜→ 🐧 Searching for solution...",
  "→→→🐜 🐧 Searching for solution..."
)

annealing_frames <- list(
  "🐧🔥🔥🔥 Searching for solution...",
  "🔥🐧🔥🔥 Searching for solution...",
  "🔥🔥🐧🔥 Searching for solution...",
  "🔥🔥🔥🐧 Searching for solution..."
)

tabu_frames <- list(
  "🗙🐧🐧🐧 Searching for solution...",
  "🐧🗙🐧🐧 Searching for solution...",
  "🐧🐧🗙🐧 Searching for solution...",
  "🐧🐧🐧🗙 Searching for solution..."

)

animation_frames <- reactive({
    switch(
    input$algorithm,
    "Ant Colony Optimization" = ant_frames,
    "Simulated Annealing" = annealing_frames,
    "Tabu Search" = tabu_frames,
    ant_frames
    )
})

current_frame <- reactiveVal(1)
animation_running <- reactiveVal(FALSE)

# Animation observer
observe({
    req(animation_running())
    
    invalidateLater(500)  # Update every 500ms
    
    # Cycle through frames
    frames <- isolate(animation_frames())
    next_frame <- isolate(current_frame()) + 1
    if (next_frame > length(frames)) {
        next_frame <- 1
    }
    current_frame(next_frame)
    
    # Check if task is done
    status <- algorithm_task$status()
    if (status %in% c("success", "error")) {
        if (debug) cat("Stopping animation - status:", status, "\n")
        animation_running(FALSE)
    }
})

observe({
    status <- algorithm_task$status()
    if (debug) cat("Checking status to stop animation:", status, "\n")
    if (status %in% c("success", "error")) {
        if (debug) cat("Stopping animation\n")
        animation_running(FALSE)
    }
})

output$status_message <- renderText({
        frame_idx <- current_frame()
        is_animating <- animation_running()
        status <- algorithm_task$status()
    #if (debug) cat("Rendering status_message | frame:", frame_idx, "| status:", status, 
    #    "| animation:", animation_running(), "\n")

    if (is_animating) {
        frames <- animation_frames()
        frames[[frame_idx]]
    } else if (status == "success") {
        paste0(input$algorithm, " Algorithm completed successfully!")
    } else if (status == "error") {
        paste0(input$algorithm, " Algorithm encountered an error.")
    } else {
        paste0("Ready to run algorithm. Current selected algorithm: ", input$algorithm)
    }
})
```

```{r}
#| context: server
#| label: run-selected-algorithm
observeEvent(input$run_algorithm, {
    if (debug) cat("\n=== RUN BUTTON CLICKED ===\n")
    if (debug) cat("Algorithm:", input$algorithm, "\n")
    
    req(input$algorithm)
    if (debug) cat("Algorithm requirement passed\n")
    
    # Start animation
    animation_running(TRUE)
    current_frame(1)
    if (debug) cat("Animation started, current_frame set to 1\n")
    if (debug) cat("animation_running():", animation_running(), "\n")

    args <- switch(
        input$algorithm,
        "Ant Colony Optimization" = list(
            ants = input$ants_value,
            evaporation = input$evaporation_value,
            lavaan.model.specs =
                list(estimator = "wlsmv", ordered = T),
            list.items = list(paste0("x", 1:10), paste0("x", 11:20), paste0("x", 21:30)),
            full = 30,
            i.per.f = c(input$iperf_value1, input$iperf_value2, input$iperf_value3),
            factors = c("f1", "f2", "f3"),
            steps = input$steps_value,
            pheromone.calculation = input$pheromone_input,
            fit.indices = c("cfi.scaled"), 
            fit.statistics.test = "(cfi.scaled > 0.90)", 
            max.run = input$maxrun_value,
            parallel = FALSE
        ),
        "Simulated Annealing" = list(
            maxSteps = input$maxSteps_value,
            temperature = input$temperature_choice,
            maxItems = c(input$maxItems_value1, input$maxItems_value2, input$maxItems_value3),
            maxChanges = input$maxChanges_value,
            items = paste0("x", 1:30),
            setChains = 1
        ),
        "Tabu Search" = list(
            numItems = c(input$numItems_value1, input$numItems_value2, input$numItems_value3),
            niter = input$niter_value,
            tabu.size = input$tabusize_value,
            lavaan.model.specs = list(
                             int.ov.free = TRUE,
                             int.lv.free = FALSE,
                             std.lv = TRUE,
                             auto.fix.first = FALSE,
                             auto.fix.single = TRUE,
                             auto.var = TRUE,
                             auto.cov.lv.x = TRUE,
                             auto.th = TRUE,
                             auto.delta = TRUE,
                             auto.cov.y = TRUE,
                             ordered = TRUE,
                             model.type = "cfa",
                             estimator = "wlsmv"
                           ),
                parallel = FALSE
        )
    )

    if (debug) cat("Args built successfully\n")
    if (debug) cat("About to invoke task...\n")
    
    tryCatch({
        algorithm_task$invoke(input$algorithm, args)
        if (debug) cat("Task invoked!\n")
        if (debug) cat("Task status immediately after invoke:", algorithm_task$status(), "\n")
    }, error = function(e) {
        if (debug) cat("ERROR invoking task:", e$message, "\n")
        animation_running(FALSE)
    })})

output$algorithm_result <- renderPrint({
    if (debug) cat("algorithm_result render called\n")
    
    status <- algorithm_task$status()
    req(status == "success")
    if (debug) cat("Status is success, getting result\n")
    
    result <- algorithm_task$result()
    if (debug) cat("Result class:", class(result), "\n")
    
    req(result)
    
    summary(result)
})

output$algorithm_plot <- renderPlot({
    if (debug) cat("algorithm_plot render called\n")
    
    status <- algorithm_task$status()
    if (debug) cat("Plot - task status:", status, "\n")
    
    result <- algorithm_task$result()
    if (debug) cat("Result class:", class(result), "\n")
    req(result)
    
    plot_type <- input$plot_choice
    if (debug) cat("Plot completed\n")
    plot(result, type = plot_type)
})
```
